gloss: to hit the mark; to come true; to be right on target

definitions.gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target
definitions.explanation: For a projectile, arrow, or shot to hit its intended target.

definitions.gloss: to come true; to prove correct; to be right on target
definitions.explanation: For a prediction, forecast, or guess to turn out to be accurate.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 (predictions coming true) is more common in everyday usage. The noun form ⟦{的中|てきちゅう}→的中：15262_tekichuu⟧ is also used, as in {的中率|てきちゅうりつ} (hit rate, accuracy rate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{的中|てきちゅう}する (a prediction comes true)
- ⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{的中|てきちゅう}する (a forecast proves correct)
- {的中率|てきちゅうりつ} (accuracy rate, hit rate)
- みごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{的中|てきちゅう}する (to prove brilliantly correct)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{命中|めいちゅう}する→命中する：26978_meichuusuru⟧: to hit (a target)
- ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to hit; to be correct
- ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: a prophecy comes true
